title: Keep hand-authored plan unit specs schema-valid

facts.note: Plan-session phase (Compose drafting loop vs Ratify before lock) must be exposed by the plan-session tooling.

Plan-session tool calls that add/upsert a unit spec or ratify the session. Activation is triggered by the operation alone: every unit added at Compose and every kept unit at Ratify is checked, whatever the validation outcome.

unit_kind carried on each plan unit spec. Open set: enforced kinds (default wagon, train, interlocking, embedded acceptance), advisory kinds (default feature, wmbt), kinds promoted via plan.spec_validation.enforce in .atdd/config.yaml, kinds with no schema (e.g. contract, checked by the writer's validator), and kinds checked by nothing.
Kept vs dropped status of each unit in the session's set at Ratify; completeness applies to kept units only. Must be exposed by the plan-session tooling.

OUTCOME of check_unit_spec, not a prerequisite for activation: valid, schema violation (schema_file, failed_field), writer-validator result, or an explicit 'not checked' report. A missing outcome for an authorable kind is itself a finding.

fires: The planner adds an ordinary, valid unit of any authorable kind at Compose: it is checked and yields a checked-valid outcome.
The planner ratifies a session: every kept unit is checked for completeness, including units that turn out valid.
The planner adds a unit at Compose whose spec carries a value violating a pattern, enum, type or additionalProperties constraint of its enforced schema.
An incomplete draft at Compose that also carries a malformed value: the malformed value is still refused at Compose.
The planner ratifies a session in which a kept unit of an enforced kind is missing a required field or violates minItems/minLength/minProperties.
A unit of an advisory kind violates its schema: findings are reported and carried on the unit to Ratify, without blocking.
A repo lists an advisory kind under plan.spec_validation.enforce in .atdd/config.yaml: violations of that kind now block like an enforced kind.
A unit of a kind with no artifact schema (e.g. contract) is added: its writer's validator must check it.
A unit of a kind that nothing checks is added: the check must say explicitly that it is not checked, not return clean.
doesNotFire: Completeness enforcement (required, minItems, minLength, minProperties) on an incomplete spec during Compose: incompleteness alone is not a defect in the draft. Well-formedness checking of the values it does carry still fires.
Completeness checking of a unit dropped (not kept) before Ratify.
Artifacts generated by atdd author outside a plan session (already schema-valid by construction).

given: A plan session where you hand-author unit specs of any authorable kind.
when: You add or re-state a unit at Compose, or ratify the session before the lock.
then: Keep every unit spec valid against its artifact schema: carried values well-formed (pattern, enum, type, additionalProperties) at Compose; kept units complete (required, minItems, minLength, minProperties) at Ratify.
prefer: Fix malformed values when Compose refuses them; re-state the unit with add_unit (upserts by ref) as it fills in.

Complete every kept unit before Ratify. Enforced (blocking) kinds by default: wagon, train, interlocking and the embedded acceptance shape — a kind blocks when its schema describes the artifacts atdd actually authors.
For a kind with no schema, rely on its writer's validator; if nothing checks it, say so explicitly.
avoid: Treating an unfinished draft at Compose as a defect, or a malformed value as fine because it is a draft.
Ratifying with failing wagon, train, interlocking, embedded-acceptance or promoted-kind specs; a failure leaves the session unlocked.
Reading a clean result from an ungoverned kind as approval.
unless: Advisory kinds (schema drifted from what atdd authors; feature and wmbt by default) report and never block; findings ride on the unit through compaction and resurface at Ratify. A repo promotes a kind via plan.spec_validation.enforce in .atdd/config.yaml.
why: atdd author is schema-valid by construction; plan specs are hand-written, so this layer must keep that guarantee. Silence that reads as approval is the defect this rule prevents.
evidence: check_unit_spec at Compose refuses malformed values of enforced kinds (test_plan_unit_spec_schema::test_compose_refuses_a_malformed_enforced_spec).
The Ratify pass validates completeness on kept units before locked is set; a failure leaves the session unlocked.
Failure evidence includes session_id, unit_ref, unit_kind, schema_file, failed_field.
Every authorable kind yields either a checked-valid result, schema findings, writer-validator findings, or an explicit 'not checked' report, never silent clean.
Advisory findings are present on the unit at Ratify and do not block unless the kind is promoted in .atdd/config.yaml.
verifier_detail: Compose (well_formedness_at_compose) checks only the values a spec carries: pattern, enum, type, additionalProperties. These are wrong the instant written; refusing them at Compose is what planner.plan.session-lifecycle asks of Compose ("candidate decomposition convention-shaped"). Applies to incomplete drafts too.

Ratify (completeness_at_ratify) checks required, minItems, minLength, minProperties only on kept units, before the lock. Compose is a drafting loop (add_unit upserts by ref so a spec can be re-stated as it fills in), so an unfinished spec is a draft there and a defect only once the operator asserts the set may be authored.

Enforced kinds RAISE: a kind whose schema describes the artifacts atdd actually authors. Measured over the source repo's plan/ tree: wagon (41/41), train (21/21), interlocking (8/8) and the embedded acceptance shape all validate, so all four enforce.

Advisory kinds REPORT and never block: a kind whose schema has drifted from the artifacts atdd authors; findings ride on the unit so they survive compaction and resurface at Ratify. feature (134/188 failing) and wmbt (294/468 failing) are advisory; wmbt.schema.json's own $comment says it is not a file gate. Promotion: plan.spec_validation.enforce in .atdd/config.yaml.

every_authorable_kind_is_governed: no authorable kind may be silently ungoverned. A kind whose artifact has no schema is checked by its own writer's validator instead; a kind checked by nothing must say so rather than return clean. contract forced this: a contract IS a JSON schema, so it has no meta-schema; omitting it from the schema table made check_unit_spec report nothing for all three rules validate_contract enforces across 14 registered contracts (#2013).
atomicity: the Ratify pass runs before locked is set, so a failure leaves the session unlocked; the same contract the interlocking, verb-object and artifact-naming gates keep.
Validation: family=presence, template=conditional_requirement, variant=planner_plan_spec_is_schema_valid, phase=CONFIRM, enforcement=confirm-blocking, subject_kind=plan-session.
failure_evidence fields: session_id, unit_ref, unit_kind, schema_file, failed_field.
Disposition strict (severity 4) applies to enforced and promoted kinds; advisory kinds are this rule's own authored exception and only report.
audit: Source name: 'Plan unit specs are schema-valid'.

splitSuggestion.then: Every authorable plan unit kind is checked by its schema or its writer's validator, or explicitly reports that it is unchecked; never silently clean.

additions.text: The 'every authorable kind is governed' obligation (S019–S023) is independent of per-spec schema validity and should be its own convention planner.plan.every-authorable-kind-is-governed; kept here in prefer/avoid/verifier_detail for losslessness.
Artifacts generated by atdd author outside a plan session.

additions.justification: Makes activation outcome-independent (valid units are checked too) and exposes the kept-unit condition the source states for Ratify; adds no obligation.
